supported_uses: Keep AC and DC certified field families separate
Normalize AC charging input from output power plus the applicable mode-specific total loss
Normalize DC charging input from output power divided by loading-adjusted efficiency
Add native idle or no-vehicle input only for the applicable non-charging duration
unsupported_inferences: Interchangeability of AC total-loss fields and DC loading-adjusted efficiency
Arbitrary selection of a future contractor product
provenance_notes: The product exports are retained as checksum-addressed evidence metadata and preserve the source's native field labels.
The native DC efficiency example is recorded exactly as displayed by the source and is not silently reinterpreted in this fixture.
